verdict.rationale: LibreChat's core work is driven by natural-language chat: agents act on plain-language requests to run code, search the web, handle files and call MCP tools or API actions, and you can invoke an agent by @-mentioning it in the chat input. However, operating the product itself (creating agents, adding tools, changing settings) is documented as done through the Agent Builder panel, MCP Settings panel, Admin Panel or librechat.yaml, not through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product configuration and management, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
